# Identity tripwire terms: strings that have NO legitimate location anywhere in
# this repo, so any reappearance is by definition a regression.
#
# These are the removed /thinking agent's machinery filenames plus two
# affiliation strings that never belong in the tree. One case-insensitive
# extended-regex pattern per line; '#' and blank lines ignored.
#
# NOTE, on purpose: ADO, Azure DevOps, and MBM are NOT listed. They have real
# homes (the ADO MCP Server project card, the employer string), so a blind grep
# cannot tell a regression from the real thing. This is a tripwire for strings
# with no valid home, not a statement that ADO/MBM are "allowed".
